wording: [Skill – I Grew With Every Bite obtained!]
holder-quote: Someone poked her. Someone poked her. Badarrow cuddled the Hobgoblin as he entered the blankets.
Snapjaw spat on her hands. Rubbed them together. Then caught the Kraken Eater’s fist again.
effect-quote: shoved him back as she grew three feet in height
